question: On what ground is liberation declared to be a lamp and the sole means of the path to liberation?
premises: Liberation is declared renowned as a lamp.
The lamp is named by quotative designation.
Liberation is held to be the sole means of the path to liberation.
inference: Liberation is designated as the lamp that is the sole means of the path to liberation.
uncertainties: Extent of lamp metaphor not specified by this verse alone
plain_english: Liberation is renowned as the lamp; thus it is said to be the sole means of the path to liberation.
